items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Now, Stabile had a very young pianist, but a black man.

ctx.x: Now, Stabile had a very young pianist, but a black man. Very fine musician. Mm-hmm. To play those kind of things in those bands, they must, by all means, be top quality. Or they cannot do the job. I could never be able to play in that because I don't have the formal training. Mm-hmm. I have the talent, but not the training. Yeah.

Well, they impressed me as having a lot of arrangements where they could do any style. Oh, yes. If you wanted a Tommy Dorsey style. Oh, yes. They got it right away. Well, somehow we got off the subject of traveling. What kind of places did you stay in when you were traveling in Texas? I mean, would you stay in a top quality hotel or whatever you could find?
